item.title: All 'Wall | Sheffield Wednesday
item.description: ALL 'WALLMillwall Football Club has a zero-tolerance policy on all forms of discrimination. item.description: Millwall Under 21s' Professional Development League meeting with Charlton Athletic on Friday afternoon was abandoned. item.title: Lions complete comeback win at Wednesday
item.description: Millwall came from behind to win 2-1 at Sheffield Wednesday in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon. Jamal Lowe gave the hosts the lead in the second-half, but two goals in three minutes - an own-goal and a strike from substitute Macaulay Langstaff - gave The Lions an important victory on the road. item.title: Matchwinner Langstaff speaks to Millwall TV+
item.description: Three goals, three matchwinners for Macaulay Langstaff in 2025/26! The striker scored The Lions' second goal in Saturday's 2-1 Sky Bet Championship victory over Sheffield Wednesday, adding the deciding goal to his strikes at Norwich City and at home to Bristol City earlier in the campaign.
